title: GSE circular peak geometry model zero-training readiness
purpose: Prove the typed causal circular model, masks, losses and rotation contract on the exact frozen development population before any optimizer or checkpoint is allowed.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training readiness over C01-C08 references plus one deterministic eight-row real batch; no optimizer, checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated 16x720 causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed PASS 180-bin circular peak-field Teacher shards.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and derived objective Teacher evidence.

worlds.fit: Exact Cartesian set S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds enumerated by the frozen shard manifest.
worlds.selection: Exact Cartesian set S01-S10 x C07-C08: 20 worlds enumerated by the frozen shard manifest.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Audit all causal references and joins, then deterministically select exactly eight unique rows covering cardinality 1/2/3/4, invalid width, circular wrap and both partitions. No resampling, fitting, augmentation or thresholding.

teacher.source: Sealed circular peak presence/residual/width-mask/profile Teacher plus sealed objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature arrays.
teacher.use: Teacher is used only to form one real masked loss and verify the model interface. Identity, pose, world and future values are excluded from forward and loss.
teacher.valid_mask: Presence has all-bin validity; width uses the independent peak-only mask; residual/profile use peak presence; global geometry uses its four-value objective mask.
teacher.student_input: Five referenced normalized range and valid-return frames only, ordered from four past frames to current.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or edge is created; future edges remain physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: All 60 C01-C06 worlds are audited; deterministic batch includes fit rows.
split.strict_test: C09/C10/M-TARE unread and absent from inputs.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only the two frozen C01-C08 source runs are read.

methods.main: Five-frame circular range-image backbone with shared 180-bin peak presence, sub-bin geometry, descriptor and uncertainty heads plus objective axis/width/height/slope/curvature heads.
methods.baseline: No performance baseline is rerun; the bound feasibility run fixes raw-range peak AP at 0.052647/0.051493.
methods.fallback: Any causality, join, rotation, mask, finite-backward, free-query or hidden-input failure stops this architecture before training.

acceptance.population: 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 peaks and exact fit/selection/cardinality counts.
acceptance.causality: All local/global five-frame references are contiguous, past-only and source-equal.
acceptance.interface: Forward accepts scans only, has no free-query parameter, outputs 180 fixed bins and all typed structure geometry.
acceptance.equivariance: 40-column input roll equals 10-bin output roll; axis rotates and global geometry remains invariant, all max errors <=3e-5.
acceptance.loss: Balanced presence and masked geometry losses are finite; invalid-width/nonpeak target perturbations change total loss by exactly zero; real batch backward is finite.

failure_policy: Fail closed without changing bins, architecture, loss masks, tolerance, rows or data; preserve a scientific FAIL for redesign.
retention: Retain summary, check table, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, selected row provenance, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal; no model checkpoint is written.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only full reference audit and one eight-row forward/backward
